A.label: the broker
A.description: Booked the load and disputes the detention hours billed.

B.label: the carrier
B.description: Ran the load and billed detention for time held at the shipper's dock.

suggestedConditions: carrier provides time-stamped arrival and departure records
broker pays the settled amount on the next settlement cycle
the detention rate for future loads is confirmed in writing
the shipper is notified about the dock delay

guidance.consent: Both sides book loads together regularly; frame the mediation as protecting a working relationship.
guidance.shuttle: Keep the discussion on documented dock time and the billed hours, not on dispatcher or driver conduct.
